Make an impact with Laerdal!

Do you want to develop cutting-edge products that train healthcare professionals and ultimately help save lives? Join us at Laerdal Copenhagen, where we build world-class digital learning solutions used by millions globally.

The Team

We are building new capabilities for RQI (Resuscitation Quality Improvement) that help hospitals run CPR training the way their organisation actually works. That means connecting the training station to the learning systems hospitals already use, removing the friction between a learner walking up to the cart and starting a session, and giving the people who implement RQI the tools to configure it for their own context. You'll help shape these capabilities and weave them into one cohesive experience. In that way, your work will directly expand access to CPR training and support Laerdal's mission to help save more lives.

We work close to our customers: we visit hospitals, test our assumptions and build on modern technology, with an eye on where resuscitation training is heading next. You will work in a cross-functional product team in Laerdal Copenhagen with product management, design and engineering, as well as with other product teams across Copenhagen, Stavanger, and the US. The team owns the core platform capabilities and collaborates closely with partners across the wider RQI ecosystem.

The Role

We are looking for a React Frontend Engineer with experience building modern web and mobile applications. In this role, you will take ownership of the key user-facing flows of the platform.

You will,

• experiment, build and maintain web and mobile user interfaces using React and React Native

• collaborate closely with backend engineers on API design and data flows

• work closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into intuitive frontend experiences

• contribute to the frontend architecture, patterns, and technical direction

• work in a "you build it, you run it" mindset with responsibility for production quality

Your Background

• Around 3+ years of professional software development experience

• Strong experience with React in production systems

• Hands-on experience with React Native and mobile development

• Understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and performance considerations

• Care deeply about usability, quality, and real user impact

• Enjoy close collaboration with designers and product managers

• Actively using AI-assisted development in your daily work

Our Tech Stack

• React (Web) & React Native (Mobile)

• C# / .NET Backend

• API‑driven integrations

• Cloud‑based infrastructure & modern CI/CD practices

Why Laerdal

Laerdal is a mission‑driven company working to help save one million more lives, every year, by 2030 (One Million Lives by Laerdal: A Shared Goal for 2030 - Laerdal - One Million Lives). You’ll be part of a collaborative, international environment with a strong focus on product quality, real‑world impact, and sustainable work–life balance.

We have a collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse close to Islands Brygge.

This is a full‑time role based at Laerdal's office in Copenhagen. We expect most workdays to be spent on‑site, with some flexibility for remote work during the week. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work closely with senior peers across engineering, product, and design.

Get a feeling of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video.

Reach Out

When you are ready to apply, please submit your CV and a short motivation letter. (remember that LinkedIn only allows one document, so just merge them into one):

• CV

• Motivation letter

If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, reach out to Lukas Zimmerli (Engineering Manager) at lukas.zimmerli@laerdal.com.

Ready to build and lead an aftermarket organization that sets the standard in our industry?

This is your chance to join Weibel and take the lead of our growing Aftermarket organization. You will join a Danish high-tech market leader with a predominantly export based customer base. We are a profitable growth company with a strong position in our core markets and ambitious plans for expansion into new and significant business areas.

As our installed base of radar systems grows worldwide, so does the importance of our aftermarket business. We offer a key leadership role with a real mandate to shape, build and develop the full aftermarket and customer support function, from people and processes to strategy and growth.

Lead aftermarket excellence for state-of-the-art radar systems

As Aftermarket Director you will have overall responsibility for how we support our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their systems. You will lead the existing Aftermarket & Training team and build new capabilities within Integrated Logistics Support (ILS), Technical Publications, Contract Management and Lifecycle Engineering. You will work closely with Sales, Programs, Product Management, R&D and Production.

Your primary responsibilities will be

• Aftermarket & Training: Lead the Aftermarket & Training team, including field service, FAT/SAT support, technical support and customer training worldwide.

• Integrated Logistics Support (ILS): Build and manage an ILS team covering logistics support analysis, spare parts and repair planning, supportability and obsolescence management.

• Technical Publications: Establish and manage technical publications, ensuring that manuals, maintenance documentation and training material meet customer and industry requirements.

• Contract Management: Own aftermarket contract management, including service and support agreements, warranty, spare parts and repair contracts – from bid to delivery.

• Lifecycle Engineering: Lead lifecycle engineering, including upgrades, modifications, reliability and maintainability improvements throughout the system lifecycle.

• Strategy and growth: Develop and execute the aftermarket strategy with a focus on customer satisfaction, recurring revenue and profitable growth.

• People leadership: Recruit, develop and lead managers and specialists, and set clear goals, KPIs and processes across the aftermarket organization.

Your qualifications and background

We are looking for a strong people leader with a relevant technical or business background and a proven track record of building and driving aftermarket, customer support or service operations for complex technical products, ideally within defense, aerospace or another high-tech industry.

You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic and results-oriented mindset. You are comfortable operating in an international environment and know how to engage effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical specialists to senior customer representatives.

We imagine that you:

• Have led aftermarket, service, support, maintenance or customer success organizations and excel at stakeholder management.

• Have a proven track record of building and scaling organizations, capabilities and operating models in a growing business environment.

• Possess a strong commercial mindset and understand how to develop service offerings, strengthen customer partnerships and drive recurring revenue.

• Have a solid understanding of lifecycle management, service contracts, supportability, logistics or integrated product support.

• Are equally comfortable setting strategic directions and driving operational execution.

• Collaborate effectively across functions and are skilled at aligning engineering, sales, production and program organizations around shared goals.

• Are familiar with AI and its business applications and actively leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making and business outcomes.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of aftermarket at Weibel. You will play a key role in strengthening customer partnerships, driving long-term growth and building an organization that supports our global ambitions.

Please note that it is a requirement that you can obtain a security clearance, since some of your tasks will involve classified information and take place in restricted areas.

RWE Renewables Denmark A/S

To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent

Join RWE’s offshore operations team as a Balance of Plant (BoP) Technician and help ensure the safe and reliable operation of Thor Offshore Wind Farm, Denmark’s largest offshore wind farm. Working in small teams alongside external service providers, you will represent RWE offshore and contribute to the inspection, maintenance and structural integrity of critical balance-of-plant assets. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor will have a capacity of more than 1 GW and generate green electricity for more than one million Danish households.

About the role

• Perform visual and technical inspections of turbine foundations, transition pieces, boat landings, internal and external ladders, and secondary steel structures.

• Identify and report corrosion, weld fatigue, structural damage and other technical faults.

• Monitor structural integrity, including checks of cathodic corrosion protection systems.

• Oversee scour protection systems around offshore foundations and coordinate with remotely operated vehicle teams to assess seabed erosion.

• Inspect and maintain foundation davit cranes and support wind turbine generator activities when required.

• Document completed work in Fluix and create fault notifications in SAP.

• Contribute to risk assessments and method statements for repair and maintenance activities.

• Coordinate the work of external service providers and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety requirements.

Job requirements and experience

• Completed vocational training as a mechanical, electrical or wind turbine technician, or an equivalent technical qualification.

• At least two years of maintenance experience within offshore wind, maritime operations or utilities.

• Strong HSEQ awareness and knowledge of relevant legislation, standards and industry requirements.

• Experience in planning and coordinating service assignments.

• Good IT skills, including experience with tools such as Microsoft Office, Fluix or SAP.

• Good spoken and written English; Danish language skills are an advantage.

• Ability to work offshore and obtain a valid GWO certificate.

• A high level of physical fitness, with the ability to work in demanding conditions and adverse weather at sea, combined with a proactive, collaborative and solution-focused approach.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

Do you want to lead one of the most exciting growth areas in the Nordic energy market?

As Head of Flexibility Solutions, you lead the strategic development, commercial growth, and operational excellence of Mind Energy’s flexibility business.

You’re leading a multidisciplinary domain being responsible for flexibility products, ancillary services, market participation, and the digital platform that enables it all. Working at the intersection of business, technology, operations, and energy markets, you will create scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value while strengthening Mind Energy's position as a leading flexibility partner in the Nordics.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

At Mind Energy, we organize around domains rather than traditional functional silos.

Each domain brings together commercial, operational, product, and technical capabilities around a shared business objective and customer outcome. This enables faster decision-making, stronger ownership, and closer collaboration across the value chain.

In this role you lead the Flexibility Domain and bring together commercial specialists, traders, product experts, developers, and operations professionals around a common mission: delivering market-leading flexibility solutions that create customer value and accelerate the energy transition.

Your mission is to:

• Define and lead the Flexibility Domain strategy, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring long-term business performance, growth, value creation, and market readiness.

• Drive the commercial development of flexibility solutions by translating customer needs, market developments, commercial opportunities, and regulatory changes into scalable products, services, business capabilities, and system initiatives.

• Co-own the roadmap and evolution of the Energy Trading Management Platform with the Product Owner, guiding investment and prioritization decisions across products, processes, and technology to deliver measurable business value.

• Ensure operational excellence across activation, monitoring, settlement, and performance management, while acting as the escalation point for critical commercial, operational, market, and system challenges and maintaining deep insight into Nordic balancing markets, ancillary services, and TSO requirements.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, turning market complexity into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and tangible results.

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

Working alongside commercial specialists, traders, developers, product experts, and operations professionals, you join a high-performing, cross-functional domain with end-to-end ownership of our flexibility business.

Combining deep market expertise with commercial, operational, and technical capabilities, the team has the mandate to make decisions that directly impact our products, customers, and business results. This setup enables close collaboration, rapid execution, and the ability to turn market complexity into scalable solutions that drive growth and support the energy transition.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are a commercially minded leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning market opportunities into scalable solutions.

You combine strategic thinking with operational execution and know how to create results through people, collaboration, and clear priorities.

We imagine you bring:

• Proven leadership experience with responsibility for people, business performance, and strategic execution, including building and developing high-performing teams

• Strong commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align commercial, operational, and technical interests to drive growth and value creation

• Experience balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and day-to-day delivery

• Relevant experience from the energy sector, preferably within flexibility, balancing markets, ancillary services, trading, or grid-related services

• Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of demand response, virtual power plants (VPPs), and balancing products such as mFRR, aFRR, and FCR is an advantage

• Proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognizing that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.
